title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1968-08-22
lineage: SBD > MR > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard source (stereo second set, mono first set) captures a blistering August ’68 show highlighted by an all‑out Alligator > Caution jam, a soaring Dark Star and a masterful The Eleven.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard capture that sounds surprisingly clear – the second half is in stereo with crisp separation while the first set runs in mono and shows a few clipping glitches. Musically the performance is often described as “hot” and “on fire,” with the Alligator‑Caution sequence, Dark Star, The Eleven and The Other One singled out as standout moments, and Jerry’s 1968 tone and solos receiving constant praise. Overall reviewers are enthusiastic, noting only minor source quirks, making this a must‑have for fans of the late‑summer ’68 run.

ai_rating.rationale: Average user rating ~4.7; most comments are glowing about performance and recording quality, with only a few minor complaints about missing tracks or mono first set.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Second set in VG stereo, very clear; first set in mono (likely radio broadcast) with occasional clipping and brief cuts. Overall sound is clean and loud enough for download, though a few edits and channel swaps are noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Show starts a bit rough with a hard‑to‑hear St. Stephen, then builds momentum through The Eleven and Death Don’t, peaking in the second‑set marathon of Alligator‑Caution, New Potato (Caboose) and closing with Good Night. Transitions are praised as tight and the overall pacing is described as a high‑energy, tightly woven jam flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for his soaring solos, ‘68 tone, endless runs and powerful vocals; his playing on Dark Star, The Eleven and Alligator is called blazing.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as aggressive and funky on bass, dueling with Jerry in The Eleven, delivering a rare extended solo during New Potato; his lines are highlighted as a key driver of the jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ and vocal contributions noted as 'perfect organ embellishments' and 'psychedelic vocals'; keyboards add depth to Dark Star and The Eleven.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill (Mickey) praised for a tight, explosive drum solo in Alligator and overall driving rhythm throughout the set.
